create_prompt_depth_image_processor: create a PromptDepthAnythingImageProcessorPil instance with custom resize, normalization, and padding parameters
preprocess_image_with_prompt_depth: preprocess RGB images and optional prompt depth maps into normalized pixel values with aspect ratio preservation
resize_image_with_aspect_ratio: resize an image to target dimensions while preserving aspect ratio and constraining to a multiple of a divisor
pad_image_to_multiple_of_divisor: center-pad an image so its height and width are multiples of a given size divisor
post_process_depth_estimation: post-process raw DepthEstimatorOutput predictions by interpolating to target image sizes
